feeds.title: DUI News Blog
feeds.description: DUI News Blog is a collective effort by some of the best DUI defense attorneys from across the country to provide the public with current DUI news and laws. Some of the best DUI defense attorneys from across the country have been selected to provide the public with current information and analyses of legal issues relating to the defense of Driving Under the Influence cases.

feeds.title: San Diego DUI Law Center Blog
feeds.description: Our San Diego DUI Lawyer provides resourceful insight on all things DUI and DMV related. Check our DUI blog for updates. Certified by California DUI Lawyers Association as one of only a few San Diego DUI Specialists, Rick has successfully defended drunk driving cases since 1983.

feeds.title: Los Angeles DUI Attorney Blog
feeds.description: Los Angeles DUI Attorney Blog - Published by Los Angeles & Southern California Criminal & DUI Defense Attorney Michael Kraut. Los Angeles DUI defense Attorneys who represent clients on violations of California Vehicle Code section 23152(a) and 23152(b) charges. The firm also handles white collar criminal defense, theft crimes, drug offenses and other criminal cases

feeds.title: Columbus OVI/DUI Attorney Blog
feeds.description: The Columbus OVI/DUI Attorney Blog is run by attorney Douglas Riddell, founder of Riddell Law LLC. Riddell has over a decade of experience defending individuals against OVI/DUI charges in Ohio. The blog covers various topics related to OVI/DUI defense, including breathalyzer tests, field sobriety tests, and Ohio's OVI/DUI laws.

feeds.title: Maryland DUI Lawyer Blog
feeds.description: The firm of Goldstein and Stamm, P.A. prides itself on its tireless efforts on behalf of its clients, aggressive courtroom style, and thorough knowledge of complex areas of the law. Leonard R. Stamm is a Maryland DUI and criminal defense lawyer with over 36 years of experience dedicated to zealously representing clients charged with drunk driving, driving under the influence (DUI), driving while impaired (DWI), and other criminal and vehicular offenses in state and federal district, circuit, and appellate courts throughout the state of Maryland.

feeds.title: Shoemaker Law Blog
feeds.description: Shoemaker Law can provide experienced legal defense for those charged with DUI/DWI and criminal traffic violations. We also represent clients in hearings against the Department of Motor Vehicles after a DUI arrest to invalidate the administrative suspension of their driver's license.

feeds.title: The Bateman Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: Being arrested for a DUI is not only an intimidating experience, but understanding your rights can be overwhelming. John Bateman, Attorney at Law, has the experience and knowledge of the judicial system to fight for you in a clear and sensible way.

feeds.title: Illinois DUI Lawyer Blog
feeds.description: Illinois Driver's License Reinstatement Attorney. represents clients in cases that involve drivers license reinstatement and DUI..

feeds.title: The Kohn Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The blog section features articles that have to do exclusively with the criminal defense sector. Some sub-topics may include but are not limited to Drug Crimes Defense, Additional Felony Defense Services, and Additional Misdemeanor Defense Services. The Kohn Law Firm is dedicated to serving the DUI and criminal defense needs of the accused in the Pikes Peak region.

feeds.title: Survive A DUI Blog
feeds.description: The Survive A DUI Blog - entries about all aspects of being arrested for a DUI and the legal and mental consequences. You should never drink and drive, but if you do get a DUI this blog is there to help you survive it- mentally and legally.

feeds.title: Orange County DUI Lawyer Blog
feeds.description: With over 25 years experience defending those accused of crime, William Weinberg has represented people accused of crimes ranging from homicides to domestic violence and white-collar fraud. Whether you're facing a first offense DUI, or a manslaughter case, I know your case is the first thing on your mind. Count on me to take your case to heart and provide the finest representation.

feeds.title: Portland DUI Guy Blog
feeds.description: Trilogy Law Group was established with a simple mission in mind, helping individuals fight unwarranted charges. They defend DUI cases, but whether you have been charged with a misdemeanor or a felony. The Portland DUI Guy blog is a great place to learn about specific aspects of DUI charges & cases in Oregon.

feeds.title: Law Offices of Taylor and Taylor Blog
feeds.description: Bad Drunk Driving Laws, False Evidence and a Fading Constitution. Lawrence Taylor is the most respected DUI attorney in the country today. A former Marine and graduate of the University of California at Berkeley (1966) and the UCLA School of Law (1969), he served as deputy county counsel, deputy public defender and deputy district attorney in Los Angeles before entering private practice.

feeds.title: Law Offices of Taylor and Taylor Blog
feeds.description: The Law Firm of Taylor & Taylor, a nationally-recognized criminal defense firm of highly experienced DUI lawyers (including 2 former prosecutors) with each attorney specializing in DUI defense, serves clients in Los Angeles, Orange County, Riverside, and San Bernardino counties.

feeds.title: Ramsay Law Firm, PLLC Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts on topics like Scientific Defenses, Developments In The Law, Legal Defenses, and more. Ramsay Law Firm is a Defense Firm focused on changing the future of DWI Defense with science.
